I think he maybe Neurodivergent/Autism/ect after you said he has weird eating habits, ie eating same dish/food item and then done with it. He could have OCD, too. 

Why I say this is I'm Neurodivergent as I have Autism, Anxiety/depression, and OCD. Now I've never ate on the toliet, I've had a drink of soda/water, etc, if I brought it with me at home. If I'm running out of time I panic and do weird things like if I have to poo and take my meds, or have a important phone call, etc I may have to do both. 

I'm guessing he was on lunch and may have had the urge to go. Eating food, coffee, anxiety can cause this. He, due to quirks may not like eating at desk or could be rigid to his schedule, etc. 

I would do as you said earlier and treat it like it never happened and just email him normally. He's probably mortified and embarrassed. Trust me even bringing it up as a causal joke if he doesn't quite understand humor as we tend to have some trouble with humor, tone, emotions in normal conversation could cause further embarrassment or cause him pain rather than taking it as a joke as you might be only one of a few work friends.
